2026-11-12.headline: Rayner approves Piddington asylum centre
2026-11-12.text: Communities Secretary Angela Rayner has granted full planning permission for a Ministry of Defence site near Piddington, Oxfordshire, to house 1,200 asylum seekers despite local opposition.

2026-11-12.headline: Two men convicted of spying for Iran
2026-11-12.text: Mostafa Sepahvand and Farhad Javadi Manesh have been found guilty of assisting Iranian intelligence by carrying out surveillance to help eliminate UK-based journalists.

2026-11-12.headline: Teenager admits knife murder in Leeds
2026-11-12.text: Kayla Smith, 18, has pleaded guilty to the murder of 16-year-old Chloe Watson Dransfield, whom she stabbed to death during a planned fight over a young man in Leeds.

2026-11-12.headline: Train collision in Egypt kills seven
2026-11-12.text: A crash involving two trains in the al-Ayyat district of Giza province, about 50km from Cairo, has left seven people dead and at least 125 injured.

2026-11-12.headline: Sect leader jailed for 200 years in Kenya
2026-11-12.text: Paul Mackenzie has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for murdering 190 children and one adult after forcing followers to starve themselves and their families.

2026-11-12.headline: Caine prize winner cleared of using AI
2026-11-12.text: Simbarashe Kundizeza, a Zimbabwean author, has been cleared of using artificial intelligence after a month-long investigation concluded his story The Blue Fighter was human-written.

2026-11-12.headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
2026-11-12.text: Jensen Huang has stepped down as Nvidia's chief executive following reports of two affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy and another with a direct report.

2026-11-12.headline: Microsoft Outlook suffers global outage
2026-11-12.text: Users around the world experienced widespread access issues for Microsoft Outlook across web and app platforms after a portion of infrastructure failed.

2026-11-12.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen
2026-11-12.text: Google has released its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, designed to better handle complex, multi-part questions, hard-to-understand typos, and highly specific user requests.

2026-11-12.headline: UK economy grows in third quarter
2026-11-12.text: The UK economy grew by 0.7% in the third quarter, achieving its fastest expansion in two and a half years amid boosted investment in artificial intelligence.

2026-11-12.headline: Metro Bank puts itself up for sale
2026-11-12.text: Metro Bank is seeking a buyer three years after its near-collapse, a transaction that could result in a 420 million pound windfall for Colombian billionaire investor Jaime Gilinski Bacal.

2026-11-12.headline: Poundland secures rescue deadline extension
2026-11-12.text: Crisis-hit budget retailer Poundland has secured an extended two-week deadline from US investment firm Gordon Brothers for a potential rescue and solvent sale.

2026-11-15.headline: Trident submarine finishes record patrol
2026-11-15.text: HMS Vengeance concluded a seven-month underwater deployment in Scotland, raising concerns about maintenance and crew impact.

2026-11-15.headline: Andy Burnham pledges youth jobs overhaul
2026-11-15.text: The prime minister promised a root-and-branch rethink of support and a benefits backstop to tackle the youth employment crisis.

2026-11-15.headline: Poundland secures rescue talks extension
2026-11-15.text: The discount chain received an extended deadline as its US owners released funds to restock stores with Yorkshire Tea and Pot Noodle.

2026-11-15.headline: Kenyan sect leader jailed for 200 years
2026-11-15.text: Paul Mackenzie was convicted of murdering 190 children and one adult after ordering followers to starve themselves.

2026-11-15.headline: Train collision in Egypt kills seven
2026-11-15.text: At least seven people died and 125 were injured when two trains collided in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, Egypt.

2026-11-15.headline: US asks about Ukraine Donbas withdrawal
2026-11-15.text: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the US asked if Ukraine would give up parts of the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership.

2026-11-15.headline: Apple smart glasses planned for June
2026-11-15.text: Bloomberg analyst Mark Gurman reported that Apple will announce its first model, lacking augmented reality features, at June's WWDC.

2026-11-15.headline: SpaceX captures Starship with tower
2026-11-15.text: SpaceX successfully executed its first chopstick catch of a Starship booster using its Mechazilla launch and catch tower in Texas.

2026-11-15.headline: LG B6E OLED TV heavily discounted
2026-11-15.text: Best Buy slashed the price of LG's 55-inch B6E OLED TV by 50 percent to an all-time low of $39.99 during a weekend event.

2026-11-15.headline: Thames Water creditors offer 75m pounds
2026-11-15.text: Creditors established a 75m pound fund for vulnerable customers to win Andy Burnham's support and avert nationalisation of Thames Water.

2026-11-15.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
2026-11-15.text: Jensen Huang stepped down following corporate scandals involving allegations of international espionage and extramarital affairs.

2026-11-15.headline: Chip app targets retail investors
2026-11-15.text: British tech company Chip is offering retail investors shares in a first for the London Stock Exchange private securities market.

2026-11-16.headline: Andy Burnham says Brexit has not worked
2026-11-16.text: Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that Brexit has not worked and announced he will sign a new deal with the EU at a summit this week to help raise GDP by 0.4%.

2026-11-16.headline: UK blood services issue urgent winter appeal
2026-11-16.text: UK blood services have appealed for 150,000 donations to help the NHS cope with surging winter demand, with certain reserves currently at half of required levels.

2026-11-16.headline: Lords report warns of UK polycrisis threats
2026-11-16.text: An influential committee of peers warned that the government is complacent about catastrophic and fast-changing security risks to the UK, including cyber-attacks, sabotage and climate change.

2026-11-16.headline: Paul Mackenzie jailed for 200 years
2026-11-16.text: Kenyan doomsday sect leader Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult after followers were ordered to starve.

2026-11-16.headline: Train collision in Egypt kills seven
2026-11-16.text: At least seven people were killed and 125 injured when two trains collided in the al-Ayyat district of Giza province, roughly 50km south of Cairo.

2026-11-16.headline: US asks Ukraine about Donbas and NATO
2026-11-16.text: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the US asked for the first time if Ukraine would withdraw from parts of the Donbas region in exchange for admission to NATO.

2026-11-16.headline: Vulcan rocket fails and destroys 40 satellites
2026-11-16.text: United Launch Alliance suffered its first mission failure in 20-year history when its Vulcan rocket failed to deliver 40 Amazon Leo satellites into orbit.

2026-11-16.headline: Tor Project issues emergency DoS fix
2026-11-16.text: The Tor Project released a rapid-response security fix for version 0.4.9-17 to defend its network against a sustained distributed denial-of-service attack.

2026-11-16.headline: Microsoft restores all global outage services
2026-11-16.text: Microsoft confirmed that all services have been fully restored following a global outage that severely impacted the NHS, police and schools across the UK.

2026-11-16.headline: Elon Musk backs Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
2026-11-16.text: Elon Musk and over 165,000 others signed an open letter calling for Nvidia to reinstate ousted co-founder and former CEO Jensen Huang following a scandal involving a suspected Chinese spy.

2026-11-16.headline: Thames Water creditors offer GBP 75m tariff boost
2026-11-16.text: Thames Water creditors proposed a GBP 75m fund for vulnerable customers to win Prime Minister Andy Burnham's support for a private rescue package and avoid nationalisation.

2026-11-16.headline: FBI seizes $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
2026-11-16.text: The FBI seized more than $1.2bn in cryptocurrency that was stolen from cryptocurrency exchange Binance during a hack last month.
